<ParamField body="children" type="ReactNode">
  Custom trigger content. Replaces the selected country presentation while retaining shared trigger behavior.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="className" type="string | ((state: PopoverTriggerState) =&gt; string | undefined)">

</ParamField>

<ParamField body="closeDelay" type="number" default="0">
  How long to wait before closing the popover that was opened on hover.
  Specified in milliseconds.

  Requires the `openOnHover` prop.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="closeOnSelect" type="boolean">
  Closes the popup after a selection. Defaults to true. Cancelled selection keeps it open.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="countries" type="readonly CountryChoice[]" required>
  Prepared country choices with unique stable string values, caller-owned labels, and optional decorative flags and disabled states. An empty string is a valid choice value.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="defaultOpen" type="boolean">
  Whether the uncontrolled popup is initially open.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="defaultPage" type="string">
  Dropdown page shown when the popup opens. Defaults to root.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="defaultValue" type="string | null">
  Initial uncontrolled selected identifier. Defaults to null.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="delay" type="number" default="300">
  How long to wait before the popover may be opened on hover. Specified in milliseconds.

  Requires the `openOnHover` prop.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="disabled" type="boolean">
  Prevents opening and selection while the trigger stays focusable. An empty country list is also disabled.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="id" type="string">

</ParamField>

<ParamField body="label" type="string">

</ParamField>

<ParamField body="noCountryLabel" type="string">

<ParamField body="noResultsLabel" type="string">

</ParamField>

<ParamField body="onInteractOutside" type="((event: DropdownDismissEvent) =&gt; void)">

### CountrySelect.Root

<ParamField body="Root.children" type="ReactNode" required>
  Picker composition containing Dropdown.Root, CountrySelect.Trigger, and CountrySelect.Options. Root adds no DOM element.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.countries" type="readonly CountryChoice[]" required>
  Prepared country choices with unique stable string values, caller-owned labels, and optional decorative flags and disabled states. An empty string is a valid choice value.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.defaultValue" type="string | null" default="null">
  Initial uncontrolled selected identifier. Defaults to null.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.disabled" type="boolean" default="false">
  Prevents opening and selection. An empty country list is also disabled. The trigger stays focusable with aria-disabled.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.noCountryLabel" type="string" default="No country">
  Text for the null selection and its option. Defaults to No country.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.onValueChange" type="((value: string | null, eventDetails: DropdownSelectionGroupChangeEventDetails) =&gt; void)">
  Reports the selected identifier or null with event, reason, trigger, cancel and isCanceled details. Call cancel() to preserve selection and keep the popup open.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.value" type="string | null">
  Controlled selected identifier. Null selects no country; undefined leaves selection uncontrolled.
</ParamField>
